title: [FIMI] Podcast Cardano on Telegram for Vietnamese

ms.promise:
1. Complete the Podcast channel on Telegram, Facebook group, YouTube channel.
- Telegram: We will publish the Podcast product updating news
about the Cardano ecosystem on a private Telegram channel linked to the largest
Telegram Community group in Vietnam with MP3 format file. The purpose is to
update the latest information about the vibrant development of the Cardano
ecosystem as quickly and accurately as possible for the Cardano Vietnam
community.
- YouTube: YouTube is the world's largest video sharing
platform, where users can upload, watch, share, and comment on Podcasts. The
main purpose is to provide a platform for users to share and enjoy Podcasts,
serving the entertainment, learning, and information needs of users.
- Facebook: Facebook is a social network that allows users to
connect with friends, family, and communities. The purpose of building a
Podcast on Facebook is to serve the needs of communication, sharing personal
and professional information, as well as discovering Podcast content.
2. Make a detailed plan for the Podcast production process.
- Determine the topic for the Podcast
- Find reliable sources of information about Cardano and compile
Podcasts, publish mp3
ms.criteria:
1. Podcast channel on Telegram, Facebook, Youtube
2. Podcast production plan (updated here)
3. 3. Minimum 80 Podcasts (at least 1200 minutes) about news and
knowledge about the Cardano ecosystem on Telegram,
Facebook, Youtube
channels.
4. Make sure to get at least 300 views/podcast
after 1 week of sharing. (Update here)

Milestone Report 1 Project [FIMI] Cardano Podcast on Telegram for Vietnamese (ID = 1200008)

3. Publish 80 Podcasts (reached 1470 minutes, exceeded the target of 270 minutes) about news and knowledge about the Cardano ecosystem on Telegram, Facebook, Youtube channel.
4. The number of listeners for each Podcast exceeded the target of over 300 views/podcast after 1 week of sharing in the Vietnam Cardano Community Telegram group with nearly 3,000 members.. (Updated here and proof photos here).
5. Podcast content is updated in column J of the online report.
6. All Indicators we update on the Online Job Board.
